signals.text: 5 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for workload orchestration and scheduling across the GPU fleet
Lead and develop a team of product managers focused on orchestration capabilities
Partner with platform engineering to define scheduling, bin-packing, and resource allocation features
Prioritize the roadmap to balance utilization, performance, and customer experience
Define and track metrics for orchestration efficiency and fleet utilization

roles.title: Group Product Manager - Security and Confidential Computing

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for platform security and confidential computing capabilities
Lead and develop a team of product managers focused on security-related product areas
Partner with security engineering and platform engineering to define and ship security features
Translate customer security and compliance requirements into product capabilities
Track confidential computing technology developments (TEEs, AMD SEV, Intel TDX) and their product implications

roles.title: Group Product Manager - Inference and Token Factory

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for inference infrastructure and token-serving capabilities
Lead and develop a team of product managers focused on inference and serving infrastructure
Partner with platform engineering to define features that improve inference throughput, latency, and cost efficiency
Track industry and customer trends in inference workloads and translate them into roadmap priorities
Define and monitor metrics for inference performance and efficiency
Own product strategy and roadmap for Volta's control plane — the Kubernetes-native layer managing compute, storage, and networking lifecycle
Lead and develop a team of product managers focused on control plane capabilities
Work closely with platform engineering to translate customer and operational needs into control plane features
Prioritize the roadmap based on customer impact, operational reliability, and platform scalability
Partner with the bring-up and operations teams to identify and address operational pain points
Own product strategy and roadmap for Volta's user-facing interfaces, dashboards, and consoles
Partner with design and engineering to define and ship intuitive, reliable user experiences
Gather and prioritize customer feedback to inform interface improvements
Define success metrics for usability, adoption, and customer satisfaction
Work closely with customer success and support to identify pain points in the current experience
